rows.description: My grandparent has died and I feel numb, then suddenly weep. Wise: grief comes in waves; talk about them, join family rituals, and let myself feel without rushing.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, guilt, indifference
related mind states: sadness, grief, detachment

rows.description: A classmate has died in an accident. I feel shaken and fear my own mortality. Wise: seek company, talk to a counsellor if it lingers, and honour them with small acts.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, guilt, indifference
related mind states: grief, fear, dread

rows.description: My parent is so lost in mourning that they seem absent. I feel doubly alone. Wise: name my own need, reach for another trusted adult, and remember their absence is grief, not lack of love.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, guilt, indifference
related mind states: affection, grief, trust

rows.description: My pet has died and people say it's just an animal. It hurts as real. Wise: love is real whichever the object; mark the loss with a small ritual.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, guilt, indifference
related mind states: affection, grief, hurt

rows.description: After the death I am angry with God or the universe. Wise: anger is part of grief and can be voiced; some find comfort in faith and some in people, and both are fine.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: grief, guilt, indifference

rows.description: A friend sits with me without giving advice. It helps more than anything. Wise: I can say what I need, whether space, company or distraction.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, grief, guilt, indifference

rows.description: I feel guilty for not saying goodbye or for a quarrel before the loss. Wise: guilt is a form of love; forgive myself and write the unsaid words in a letter.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, grief, indifference

rows.description: Classmates go on as normal and say nothing about my loss. Wise: people often don't know what to say; tell one or two what would help.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, grief, guilt

rows.description: I fail in front of everyone like a missed goal or a stage freeze, and they laugh. Wise: shame fades faster than I expect; laugh at it if I can, and try again.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, contempt, disillusionment, loyalty, shame

rows.description: I replay the failure at night and cringe. Wise: tell a friend, since sharing shrinks it; treat the memory as data and not as a verdict.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, contempt, disillusionment, loyalty, mockery
